title: Theory that shooter Valente was awaiting programmed instruction

tellings.quote: Or maybe he was awaiting instruction, subliminal or conscious instruction.

plain: A shooter named Valente, linked to events in 2025 around Boston, Providence and Brooklyn, may have been waiting for instructions, "subliminal or conscious", according to an idea Michels floats himself in an episode on missing American scientists. He offers it as a possibility, without naming a source. If true, the shooter would have been acting on someone else's programming.
